candidate.answerReason: Each of the four angles has two adjacent partners. Counting from each angle counts every linear pair twice, giving 4×2÷2=4.

methods.label: Count each pair twice
methods.explanation: Each angle forms a linear pair with 2 other angles, giving \(4\times2\div2=4\) pairs.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 linear pairs and elementary multiplication and division to account for counting each pair twice.
